title: Animal Features and Groups
seo_title: Grade 2 Science: Animal Features and Groups Worksheets (Ontario Curriculum)
standard_text: Describe the features of animals and how they help them live; sort animals into groups (mammals, birds, fish, reptiles, amphibians, insects) and by what they eat. (summary of the Ontario Science and Technology curriculum, 2022, Strand B: Life Systems – Growth and Changes in Animals)
meta_desc: Free Grade 2 science worksheets on animal groups, body parts and what animals eat, with pictures. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Animal body parts help them live.
key_sub: Feathers, fur, fins and webbed feet each have a job. We sort animals into groups.
body_html:
How to think about it

We can sort animals by their body parts and what they eat.

  • Birds have feathers; mammals have fur.
  • Fish have fins; insects have six legs.
  • Some eat plants, some eat meat, some eat both.
Example

Which group has feathers?

robins and geese

Answer: birds

Example

What does a wolf eat?

it hunts

Answer: meat

Common mistakes

  • Thinking bats are birds (they are mammals).
  • Thinking spiders are insects (they have eight legs).
